aiToTestSolution.aiStatement: The Product Code Data Segment (102) length in this example is 49 bytes including Field Separators and Product Data Field Delimiters.
aiToTestSolution.testRequirementTitle: Segment 103 maximum length is 3,334 alphanumeric characters.

aiToTestSolution.aiStatement: When EBT Program Data (Element 164) is used in a request containing a HIP purchase/return amount, Subelement 1 (Total Length) is formatted n3, right-aligned, zero-filled, and specifies the total length of all data in the entire message (e.g. '024' means 24 characters follow).
aiToTestSolution.testRequirementTitle: EBT Program Data is bounded to 267 bytes and begins with a 3-digit Total Length subelement with maximum value 264.

aiToTestSolution.aiStatement: Within EBT Program Data (Element 164), the TAG subelement value '50' indicates a HIP purchase/return amount follows; TAG is format n2.
aiToTestSolution.testRequirementTitle: EBT Program Data subelement with TAG 50 requires ACCOUNT TYPE fixed value 98 (not required when TAG is IT).

aiToTestSolution.aiStatement: Within EBT Program Data (Element 164), the LEN subelement is format n2 and indicates the length of the Detail data that follows (e.g. '20' indicates 20 characters follow).
aiToTestSolution.testRequirementTitle: EBT Program Data is bounded to 267 bytes and begins with a 3-digit Total Length subelement with maximum value 264.

aiToTestSolution.aiStatement: Example EBT Program Data value '02450209850840C000000001234' demonstrates Element 164 format for a request containing one set of subelements (a HIP purchase/return amount).
aiToTestSolution.testRequirementTitle: EBT Program Data is bounded to 267 bytes and begins with a 3-digit Total Length subelement with maximum value 264.

aiToTestSolution.aiStatement: When the EBT Program Data element is used in a request containing a HIP Purchase/Return Amount, Subelement 2 ACCOUNT TYPE must be '98' (HIP Account Type).
aiToTestSolution.testRequirementTitle: EBT Program Data subelement with TAG 50 requires ACCOUNT TYPE fixed value 98 (not required when TAG is IT).

aiToTestSolution.aiStatement: When the EBT Program Data element is used in a request containing a HIP Purchase/Return Amount, AMOUNT TYPE must be '40' (HIP Amount Type). Note: the raw value shown is '50' but the valid value is stated as 40.
aiToTestSolution.testRequirementTitle: EBT Program Data subelement with TAG 50 requires ACCOUNT TYPE fixed value 98 (not required when TAG is IT).

aiToTestSolution.aiStatement: CURRENCY CODE subfield must be '840' (US Dollars) when used in a HIP Purchase/Return Amount request.
aiToTestSolution.testRequirementTitle: EBT Program Data subelement with TAG 50 requires ACCOUNT TYPE fixed value 98 (not required when TAG is IT).

aiToTestSolution.aiStatement: AMOUNT DESCRIPTOR must be one of '0', 'C', or 'D', where 0 or C indicate a credit amount and D indicates a debit amount.
aiToTestSolution.testRequirementTitle: EBT Program Data subelement TAG must be one of the documented values (50, IT for requests; 51, 52 for responses).

aiToTestSolution.aiStatement: DETAIL (HIP purchase/return amount) is a 12-digit numeric with two assumed decimal places, right-aligned and zero-padded (e.g., '000000001234' = $12.34).
aiToTestSolution.testRequirementTitle: EBT Program Data is bounded to 267 bytes and begins with a 3-digit Total Length subelement with maximum value 264.

testSolutionWithoutConfirmedAiMatch.title: Segment 103 is a Data Section 3 companion segment usable in any Data Section 3 field slot.
Segment 103 is required when the transaction flow needs EBT-specific data.
Field order matches Section 12.4 (Segment Type, Segment Length, Clerk ID, Voucher ID, WIC Discount Amount, WIC Product Data, EBT Program Data).
Request serialization: every Segment 103 field is separated by a Field Separator, including empty fields.
Response serialization: there is no Field Separator between Segment 103 fields.
WIC Discount Amount maximum length is 40 bytes, composed of one or more 20-byte positional blocks.
Segment 103 appears exactly once per message.
eWIC does not support Return transactions.
eWIC operations use a recognized prompt-code set (3086, S086, E086, 0086, 8086) carried in the companion Segment 100 Prompt Code.
